title: sgRNA Library Generation using the Molecular Chipper Approach
protocol: Mix multiple pieces of DNA in an equal molar ratio.
Ligate the DNA pool using excessive T4 DNA ligase at a concentration of 4,000 units per microgram of DNA for 3 hours at 37°C.
Run 10 μl or 200 ng of ligation products on a 1% agarose gel with 0.5 μg/ml ethidium bromide in 1X TAE buffer to check the sizes of ligation products (usually >10 kb on average).
Purify ligated large amount of DNA by ethanol precipitation.
Add 10% volume of 3M sodium acetate, pH 5.2 to the DNA sample.
Add 2 volumes of 100% ethanol and mix thoroughly.
Precipitate in -20°C for one hour.
Spin down using a pre-cooled microcentrifuge for 10 minutes.
Wash precipitated DNA with 70% ethanol.
Air dry precipitated DNA for one minute.
Re-suspend the dried DNA in 150 μl of water.
Sonicate ~14 ug of input DNA (ligated if from multiple pieces) in 120 ul of water for 90 seconds to generate random fragments peaking at sizes of 400-450bp.
Run at least 2-4 ul (~250-500 ng) of sonicated DNA on a 2% agarose gel with ethidium bromide to check peak fragment sizes.
Repair sonicated DNA fragments in an End Repair reaction using 15 ul of NEBnext End Repairing Enzyme Mix in a total volume of 150 ul.
Purify the 400-450 bp DNA fragments from the repair reaction by running on a 1% agarose gel and visualizing with CYBR Safe in a blue-light gel dock.
Extract purified DNA fragments using QIAEX II Gel Extraction Kit.
Prepare an EcoP15I-adaptor by annealing two oligonucleotides aaaactcgagcagcagtggatccG and /5phos/Cggatccactgctgctcgag in equal molar ratio in 1X ligation buffer.
Ligate 12 μg of DNA fragments with 6.0 μg of the annealed EcoP15I-adaptor at a 1:10 molar ratio using T4 DNA ligase for 3 hours at 37°C.
Purify adaptor-ligated DNA fragments from adaptor monomer and other non-specific bands by running on 1% agarose gels and using QIAEX II Gel Extraction Kit.
Digest 5 μg of EcoP15I-adaptor-ligated gel-purified DNA with 100 units of EcoP15I enzyme for 1 hour at 37°C.
Run 15 μl of the digestion on a 4% low-melting-point agarose gel with ethidium bromide to visualize the 38 bp DNA fragment.
Clean the EcoP15I digestion reaction by phenol/PCI/chloroform extraction, ethanol precipitation, and resuspension in 50 μl water.
Precipitate digestion products.
Gel-purify precipitated digestion products on a 4% low-melting-point agarose gel to obtain a ~38-bp DNA fragment pool.
Dilute the gel slice with 2 volumes of 1X TAE buffer.
Melt the gel slice at 70°C on a heating block.
Extract by phenol/PCI/chloroform.
Dissolve DNA in 20 μl water.
Ligate 280 ng of purified 38-bp DNA pool to the rest of sgRNA backbone in a 50 μl reaction with 4,000 units of T4 DNA ligase for 3 hours at 37°C.
Clean the ligated sgRNA DNA pool by QIAquick PCR Purification Kit.
Digest the cleaned pool in 50 μl with 20 units each of BamHI and HindIII overnight at 37°C.
Gel-purify the digested product using a 4% low-melting-point agarose gel and the MiniElute Gel Extraction kit to obtain a ~115-bp sgRNA pool.
Quantify the sgRNA pool by SYBR Safe Gel Stain on a fluorometer.
Ligate the sgRNA pool at a 3:1 molar ratio with 40 units of T4 DNA ligase per 100 ng total DNA in a 10 μl reaction at room temperature overnight into BamHI-HindIII sites of pSUPER-CRISPR vector.
Ethanol precipitate the ligation products and dissolve in 10 μl water.
Transform the ligation products into NEB5 alpha competent cells by electroporation using GenePulser Xcell.
Pool together transformed cells and plate several small fractions to estimate total transformed clones.
Grow up to miniprep DNA for 10-20 colonies using QIAprep Spin Miniprep Kit.
Confirm cloned sgRNA inserts by Sanger sequencing using oligo nucleotide ctccctttatccagccctca.
Grow the transformation culture overnight in 100 ml of LB medium containing 100 μg/ml ampicillin for plasmid DNA preparation.
